title: Finite local constancy of abelian sheaves is detected on underlying sets
statement: Let $Y$ be any scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and $G$ an abelian sheaf on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Let $|G|$ be its underlying sheaf of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Then $|G|$ is locally constant with finite stalks at every algebraically closed geometric point [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] if and only if $G$ is locally constant as an abelian sheaf [def-constructible-locally-constant] and its stalks at every such point are finite sets. No quasi-compactness, connectedness or nonemptiness is assumed.

proof.text: Forget an abelian trivializing cover using Mathlib instIsConstantObjSheafSheafCompose; restriction and forgetting agree definitionally. For every algebraically closed geometric point, Point.sheafFiberCompIso for forget AddCommGrpCat identifies the set-valued fiber with the underlying abelian fiber. Supply the smaller filtered-colimit preservation instance by preservesFilteredColimitsOfSize_shrink and transport Finite through the resulting equivalence in both directions.

Given a locally constant underlying set sheaf with finite stalks, discard empty cover members by restricting the index type to members with nonempty domain; cover surjectivity is preserved directly. Choose the constant value S from each retained chart. The private proved helper finite_constant_value chooses the algebraic-closure point of a domain point and identifies S with the original underlying stalk: compose overSheafEquivFunctorObjOverIso, constantSheafSheafCongrIso, upperStarCompSheafFiberIso, sheafFiberCompIso, and the generic sheafFiberConstantSheafIso. Transport the assumed finiteness across this equivalence.

Apply finite_constant_abelian_refinement to each finite chart. Choose the component refinements and bind the original cover with them. Its restrictions are definitionally the composite restrictions in that theorem, yielding a LocallyConstantDatum G. Combine this with the stalk-finiteness comparison from step 1. The subtype construction gives the empty cover when the base is empty.

proof_origin.place: Generic constant-sheaf and stalk isomorphisms prove the finite-value and forgetting steps; step 2 finite-operation refinement isolated in lem-weil-pbc-finite-constant-abelian-refinement. The main Lean theorem contains the proved assembly.

theorem finite_local_abelian_forget_iff {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (G : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    IsFiniteLocallyConstantEtaleSheafOfSets
      ((sheafCompose Y.smallEtaleTopology (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj G) ↔
    IsLocallyConstantSheaf G ∧
      ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y),
        Finite (((pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj G)
